chemistry-killer-02.title: Kiyayewar mass, ƙayyadadden rabon abubuwa, exothermic da endothermic (Inquiry)
chemistry-killer-02.topic: Kiyayewar mass, ƙayyadadden rabon abubuwa, exothermic da endothermic (Inquiry)
chemistry-killer-02.goal: Analyze the principles of Kiyayewar mass, ƙayyadadden rabon abubuwa, exothermic da endothermic (Inquiry) and deduce the correct conclusion under given conditions.
chemistry-killer-02.material:
A yanayin zafi da matsin lamba tsayayye, hydrogen ($\mathrm{H_2}$) yana amsawa da oxygen ($\mathrm{O_2}$) ya samar da tururin ruwa ($\mathrm{H_2O}$(g)). Jimillar girman iskar gas da aka auna a zafi da matsin lamba iri ɗaya bayan cikakkiyar amsawar gaurayen iskar gas daban-daban kamar haka ne (duk tururin ruwa gas ne).
(I) $\mathrm{H_2}$ 30 mL + $\mathrm{O_2}$ 20 mL → jimilla 35 mL bayan amsawa
(II) $\mathrm{H_2}$ 20 mL + $\mathrm{O_2}$ 20 mL → jimilla 30 mL bayan amsawa
Lokacin da aka sa gauraye mai 60 mL na $\mathrm{H_2}$ da $\mathrm{O_2}$ ya amsa gaba ɗaya a zafi da matsin lamba iri ɗaya, jimillar girman iskar gas bayan amsawa ya kasance 45 mL kuma $\mathrm{O_2}$ kawai ya rage ($\mathrm{H_2}$ bai rage ba). Wane haɗi ne ya nuna daidai da jeri girman $\mathrm{H_2}$ kafin amsawa da girman $\mathrm{O_2}$ da ya rage bayan amsawa?
chemistry-killer-02.thinking.0: Kiyayewar mass, ƙayyadadden rabon abubuwa, exothermic da endothermic (Inquiry)
chemistry-killer-02.s.s1.prompt:

(I) $\mathrm{H_2}$ 30 mL + $\mathrm{O_2}$ 20 mL → jimilla 35 mL bayan amsawa
(II) $\mathrm{H_2}$ 20 mL + $\mathrm{O_2}$ 20 mL → jimilla 30 mL bayan amsawa
Lokacin da aka sa gauraye mai 60 mL na $\mathrm{H_2}$ da $\mathrm{O_2}$ ya amsa gaba ɗaya a zafi da matsin lamba iri ɗaya, jimillar girman iskar gas bayan amsawa ya kasance 45 mL kuma $\mathrm{O_2}$ kawai ya rage ($\mathrm{H_2}$ bai rage ba). Wane haɗi ne ya nuna daidai da jeri girman $\mathrm{H_2}$ kafin amsawa da girman $\mathrm{O_2}$ da ya rage bayan amsawa?
chemistry-killer-02.s.s1.explain:
Mataki na 1: Tabbatar da rabon girma daga (I) da (II). (II): H2 20 mL yana amsawa da O2 10 mL ya samar da H2O 20 mL kuma O2 10 mL ya rage → jimilla 30 mL.
